site_images_format: Per-image log for every image the website references (TSA-038). Required on each item: id, url (the path the site serves), kind, source_file, creator, licence, rights_status, reviewed_by, review_date, people_depicted, child_depicted, consent, release_ref, logged_on. kind: drawn-svg | generated-illustration | social-card. rights_status: unreviewed | reviewed. 'reviewed' needs reviewed_by (a named person or role) and review_date. Nothing is marked reviewed by an agent. people_depicted and child_depicted: true | false, set by a person for each new image. consent: not_needed_no_person_shown | written | legal_representative | pending. Rule: if people_depicted is true, consent must be written or legal_representative and release_ref must name the release. Rule: if child_depicted is true, release_ref is required (TSA-021). Signed releases stay outside the repo; release_ref names where they are kept. Removal requests: handled through the support address in site/src/lib/site.ts within a period the maintainer sets (TSA-038). Tested by site/src/lib/asset-provenance.test.ts, which fails when a picture, illustration or social card has no entry, or an entry points at a file that no longer exists.
